With everyone sharing Opus 5.5 made motion graphics animation - I had to give it a try. It really is THAT GOOD! 

I gave Claude zero direction - I just told it to destroy Astra. Here’s the prompt:

So - I want you to just show off for me. You pick the design style, the look, subject etc. I just want to be extremely impressed by the motion graphic video that you create. I want you to destroy GPT 6 when it comes to motion graphics video - because astra just wants to give me a stupid glorified powerpoint presentation.”

Opus 5.5 High effort
